data.long_meaning: The name Willamina is derived from the Greek name 'Willamene', which means 'Will of God'. This name is a combination of 'Will', meaning 'desire or volition', and 'Amen', meaning 'so be it' or 'truth'. Willamina was a name given to girls in the early Christian era, symbolizing a deep connection to God and a strong desire to follow His will.
